haymaker.name: Haymaker
haymaker.desc: A guaranteed hit on an adjacent monster for double damage.

arc_bolt.name: Arc Bolt
arc_bolt.desc: Zap the nearest visible monster within 6 tiles for 6 + 2 x level + INT modifier. No roll to hit: lightning finds a way.

scout_report.name: Scout Report
scout_report.desc: For 20 turns, see exact hit chances and expected damage for every visible monster, both ways.

field_brew.name: Field Brew
field_brew.desc: Turn one piece of junk from your pack into a random potion, anywhere.

rile_up.name: Rile Up
rile_up.desc: Your companion does double damage for 5 turns.

crowd_work.name: Crowd Work
crowd_work.desc: For 10 turns kills earn triple viewers and your companion hits 50% harder.

pocket_popper.name: Pocket Popper
pocket_popper.desc: Throw a free Party Popper Bomb at the nearest visible monster.

supply_drop.name: Supply Drop
supply_drop.desc: Open the shop wherever you are for one purchase, plus a free Fizzy Tonic. Once per floor.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: Parry the next 2 attacks against you and strike back each time.
